reason: The Nāth cry joins 'alakh' and 'nirañjan' as one epithet of the supreme; not a textual definition.
Hindi usage puts the tenth door at the crown, the Amaraughaśāsana at the śaṅkhinī-mouth; graded contested.
Yogaviṣaya 29 says the haṃsa is called so 'ham.
HYP 4.3 lists them as names of one state.
HYP 4.3–4 lists sahajā with unmanī among synonyms; the standpoint is that synonym list.
The Akulavīra is the realised Akula; the text does not equate the words.
